field_descriptions.action_application: An application that can complete the request.
field_descriptions.action_platform: The high level platform(s) where the Action can be performed for the given URL. To specify a specific application or operating system instance, use actionApplication.
field_descriptions.application: An application that can complete the request.
field_descriptions.content_type: The supported content type(s) for an EntryPoint response.
field_descriptions.encoding_type: The supported encoding type(s) for an EntryPoint request.
field_descriptions.http_method: An HTTP method that specifies the appropriate HTTP method for a request to an HTTP EntryPoint. Values are capitalized strings as used in HTTP.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.url_template: An url template (RFC6570) that will be used to construct the target of the execution of the action.
